summary: Major bounded to KITTI-360's broad annotation-free training claim: annotation-derived dynamic tracks select pseudo-label targets. Minor cross-dataset numerical substitutions. Semantic zero-shot inference and SemanticKITTI's no-filter branch are not refuted.

problems.title: KITTI-360 training-target construction depends on annotation-derived dynamic tracks
problems.outcome: Demonstrated core supervision-claim contradiction for the described KITTI-360 branch
problems.claim: The p3 comparison states no requirement for manually labeled 3D datasets; p6 describes GT labels as used solely for evaluation/ablations.
assumptions: Dataset dynamic-track boxes explicitly used as stated in A2
A2 rejects a complete pseudo-mask ID if any window frame has box overlap above the unreported threshold
Official KITTI360 v2 paper documents human-provided primitive size and keyframe poses; annotation tool supplies intermediate positions
No semantic class ID consumption, test leakage, specific threshold, or score change assumed
problems.check: Combine directly inspected paper-declared target-selection rule with parent-viewed primary dataset provenance; keep(k)=not exists passing track-overlap predicate. Reviewer-owned Boolean dependency certificate and separate auxiliary challenge.
problems.result: Annotation geometry determines retained training targets upstream of Hungarian matching/mask and associated CLIP/prototype supervision. A nonmatching predicate set keeps a mask; one matching frame rejects it. This is a structural dependence, not a numerical dataset experiment.
problems.counterevidence: Narrow semantic-label-free interpretation can remain true; p6 can be read locally as benchmark voxel labels. SemanticKITTI preserves moving tubes without this filter. The appendix discloses the step. Automatic detection is suggested but not demonstrated. No concealment, test-label leakage, score error, or full-model impossibility claimed.
problems.impact: Major: the demonstrated supervision regime materially contradicts a central broad unlabeled-learning advantage for one central experimental branch. No whole-paper collapse or measured benchmark loss is required.

correction.status: Precise textual qualification verified; experimental replacement not verified
correction.statement: Describe KITTI360 as annotation-assisted dynamic filtering with semantic zero-shot inference. To substantiate full annotation freedom, replace/remove the track filter, regenerate affected targets, retrain and evaluate under documented splits.

problems.title: Dataset-specific performance numbers copied into the wrong prose comparisons
problems.claim: Mainp7 assigns KITTI360 SO17.12 and64.63%ofPaSCo; C3p21 assigns SemanticKITTI PaSCo19.53/26.29.
assumptions: Use explicitly labeled table datasets and SO/ZS settings
Use PaSCoM1 for the stated percentage
Do not infer raw-evaluation error from contradictory narrative
problems.check: Exact rational arithmetic and direct inspection of repeated tables and original PDF pages.
problems.result: KITTI360 SO12.56/PaSCo19.53=64.3113%; SemanticKITTI17.12/26.49=64.6282%. Main score overstatement4.56points. Correct SemanticKITTI PaSCo scores26.49/31.42. The13.12 value in the preceding C3 sentence is CLIP semantics, not SO; its77.27% ratio is arithmetically correct.
problems.counterevidence: Tables1,13,14 consistently retain correct KITTI360 score; main ZS13.12/8.57 are unaffected. Broad comparison directions survive the correction.
problems.impact: Minor local error in quantitative narrative; no supported change to raw benchmark results or principal ranking.

correction.statement: Replace KITTI360 sentence with12.56/64.31%; replace SemanticKITTI PaSCo comparison with26.49/31.42; distinguish SO andCLIP in C3.

no_issue_found.scope: Partial mask versus binary occupancy supervision
no_issue_found.result: Distinct target coverages and ignored unlabeled-mask/prototype voxels are intentionally specified; no invalid objective algebra demonstrated.
Training-only prototype label head is discarded at inference, preserving continuous CLIP-to-text prompting; fixed18 prototypes does not logically limit output classes to18.
Operates over existing occupied voxels, retains original labels, leaves CLIP unchanged; paper explicitly distinguishes occupancy from mask-label coverage.
Temporal RGB/Lidar preparation and Lidar-only inference are distinguished. No universal hidden-shape identification theorem is claimed or imposed.
